spotify-green.$description: Spotify Green — Green supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

signal-red.$description: Signal Red — Red supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Use as a supporting accent, not as a status color

void-black.$description: Void Black — Page canvas, top nav background, deepest surface layer

carbon.$description: Carbon — Card surfaces, sidebar panels, secondary surface layer above canvas

graphite.$description: Graphite — Elevated surface — hover states, input fields, selected nav items

smoke.$description: Smoke — Active navigation background, subtle highlight wash

iron.$description: Iron — Input borders, subtle dividers between surface layers

steel.$description: Steel — Muted UI elements, secondary borders

fog.$description: Fog — Muted text, secondary icon fills, inactive nav icons

mist.$description: Mist — Secondary text, metadata, artist names, timestamps

bone.$description: Bone — Input placeholder text, subtle captions

pure-white.$description: Pure White — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

promo-gradient.$description: Promo Gradient — Sign-up banner gradient endpoint — energetic blue anchor

magenta-glow.$description: Magenta Glow — Promotional banner gradient start — vivid pink-to-blue sweep for marketing CTAs

spotifymixui.$description: Body, navigation, buttons, metadata, small labels — compact and information-dense, designed to disappear so artwork dominates

spotifymixuititle.$description: Section headings ('Trending songs', 'Popular artists') — heavy bold weight at modest size keeps headlines assertive without overwhelming card grids
